intro: Backend Engineer & Systems Architect, quietly obsessive about clean architecture, high-performance systems, and hardware-software integration.
paragraphs: I am a Backend Software Engineer and Systems Architect with a strong foundation in Artificial Intelligence and Robotics. My expertise lies in designing scalable microservices, low-level network programming, and distributed systems. I am passionate about writing highly optimized code, solving complex architectural challenges, and building resilient backend infrastructures.

With deep knowledge of modern Java (up to version 21), Spring Boot, Micronaut, and message brokers like Redis (Pub/Sub & Streams) and NATS, I specialize in crafting high-throughput server environments. My background in embedded systems (C/C++, ESP32) uniquely positions me to bridge the gap between advanced software logic and physical hardware.

highlights.title: Systems Architecture & Backend
highlights.body: Designing robust microservices, RESTful APIs, and distributed event-driven systems using Java, Spring Boot, PostgreSQL, and Redis.

highlights.title: Low-Level & Network Programming
highlights.body: Building high-performance proxies, defense-in-depth security, and custom protocols utilizing Netty and bytecode generation.

highlights.title: AI & Embedded Systems
highlights.body: Applying machine learning, image processing, and developing hardware integrations using C/C++ and ESP32 microcontrollers.

education.degree: Diploma in AI and Robotics Engineering
education.details: Graduated with honors. Key focus areas included Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, Image Processing, Embedded Systems, C++, and Object-Oriented Principles.
